name: AlternatingVowelConsonantShift

description_json.name: Alternating Vowel-Consonant Shift
description_json.idea: To increase complexity while maintaining strict reversibility and ease of implementation, this cipher separates characters into vowels and consonants. Vowels are shifted forward by 3 positions within the vowel set, and consonants are shifted forward by 5 positions within the consonant set. Case is preserved. Digits, spaces, and punctuation remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
1. Define the vowel set: 'aeiou' (lowercase) and 'AEIOU' (uppercase).
2. Define the consonant set: 'bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxyz' (lowercase) and 'BCDFGHJKLMNPQRSTVWXYZ' (uppercase).
3. For any character in the plaintext:
   a. If it is a lowercase vowel, shift it forward by 3 positions in 'aeiou' (wrapping around: index = (index + 3) % 5).
   b. If it is an uppercase vowel, shift it forward by 3 positions in 'AEIOU' (index = (index + 3) % 5).
   c. If it is a lowercase consonant, shift it forward by 5 positions in the lowercase consonant set (index = (index + 5) % 21).
   d. If it is an uppercase consonant, shift it forward by 5 positions in the uppercase consonant set (index = (index + 5) % 21).
   e. If it is any other character (digit, space, punctuation), leave it unchanged.

   b. If it is an uppercase vowel, shift it backward by 3 positions in 'AEIOU' (index = (index - 3) % 5).
   c. If it is a lowercase consonant, shift it backward by 5 positions in the lowercase consonant set (index = (index - 5) % 21).
   d. If it is an uppercase consonant, shift it backward by 5 positions in the uppercase consonant set (index = (index - 5) % 21).
   e. If it is any other character, leave it unchanged.
